newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean retail petrol prices to fall - refiners.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean retail petrol prices to fall - refiners.

text.p: Petrol prices at South Korean pumps will drop to a range of 827-832 won a litre on Thursday from 831-837 won in April, oil refiners said on Wednesday.
They said the cut in petrol prices reflected a decline in world crude oil prices.

Yukong Ltd and LG-Caltex Oil Corp will reduce their retail petrol price to 832 won a litre from 837 won, Ssangyong Oil Refining Co and Hyundai Oil Refinery Co to 828 won from 832 won and Hanwha Energy Co Ltd to 827 won from 831 won.
Prices of kerosene and diesel will also decline, refiners said.
From January 1, domestic prices of gasoline, kerosene, diesel and C-type fuel were deregulated and no longer subject to a government-set monthly price ceiling.
